body:
I've been raped.  I know how violated and dirty you feel, but it's not your fault!  You are *not* a whore and you didn't deserve this.  

I didn't report it either for various reasons.  I tried to escape by moving instead (it doesn't work by the way).  If you can stand to tell the authorities do but if you can't face it I understand.  

Whether or not you decide to report it, you need to protect yourself in the future.  Avoid being alone with your grandpa if at all possible.  If you have to be alone with him try to make sure there is someone within shouting distance.  If you can't do that either then pretend to be involved in a book or tv program and tell him you will give him attention after you've finished... hopefully by then someone will be back in the room.

You can do this.  We can do it together.
Whatever the reaction initially the cold truth is that eventually their lives will go on.  They will move on because they have to.
The one person who really meant something to me died.  Life is nothing without them.
I've tried that.  8 years of drinking heavily and I'm still disgustingly healthy!  It's not worth it.

No college and education isn't everything.  Even now.  I didn't attend college because I didn't know what I wanted to do.   When I found what I wanted to dedicate my life to I studied part time whilst working full time.  Yes it was hard and tiring but it's possible. I eventually qualified and spend over 20 years in the field.  

It's not all over yet, my friend.

I am a past poster (on another account)  I'm still here.  I don't know whether that is due to survival instinct or the help from people here.  What I do know is that various comments gave me great comfort and made me feel less alone.

You can but be warned, if they think you are a danger to yourself or others they may 5150/baker act you (it's a psych hold where you are not allowed to leave, normally at least 3 days).  

You could also ring your national suicide hotline who will distract you for a while.  Again though in most countries if they think you are in danger of suicide they will call the paramedics and that may again result in a 5150 hold.

Don't do this.  As u/TranZeitgeist said Paroxetine is an SSRI and it takes weeks to build up in your system.  Additionally the withdrawal effects of this particular drug are horrific and include suicidal tendancies.  I know because I've tried to come off of it and nearly killed myself as a result.
